purpose: Pre-registered state perturbations to exercise the two required-but-missing H12 branches (MacromolecularComplexation network_ge2_fires, ProteinProcessingII transferase_fires) that never occur naturally in the accepted 50-seed catalog-domain oracle trace. Authored and committed BEFORE any perturbed-state MATLAB/Octave execution. No value below was chosen by inspecting a perturbed-state execution outcome and iterating until a desired verdict appeared; every value is derived from (a) the vendored Karr source's own formulas, (b) static fixture stoichiometry/rate constants, and (c) the REAL per-seed/per-tick pool ranges already observed in the existing accepted natural oracle trace for the same process (data/m1_sources/karr_native/per_process_traces_v2/).
anti_fitting_statement: Values were derived by hand computation from the formulas below and validated once, before finalizing this file, by direct execution of the vendored Karr functions to confirm the intended REGIME (guard passes vs. fails; ub>0 vs ub==0) was reached -- not to tune toward a specific complex count or exact-match outcome. No iteration against a 'desired' pass/fail result took place after this file was written; this file is the single source of truth for the perturbed states subsequently executed.

execution_engine.tool: GNU Octave 6.4.0 (apt package octave=6.4.0-2, Ubuntu 22.04 / WSL)
execution_engine.not_matlab_caveat: This environment has no MATLAB license/installation and MATLAB execution in this project is documented BOOTSTRAP-ONLY (scripts/matlab/README.md), requiring a human-driven MATLAB Online session. Octave is used here as a real, locally-executable engine running the VERBATIM vendored Karr .m logic (function bodies transcribed unmodified from data/karr_vendored_source/*.m; only the WholeCell RandStream/base-Process classdef scaffolding -- which is not vendored and not required by these two isolated code paths -- is replaced by minimal harness stubs, documented per-scenario below). Where a scenario's RNG-dependent code path IS exercised (MacromolecularComplexation network>=2), Octave's Mersenne-Twister RNG state is NOT guaranteed bit-identical to MATLAB's RandStream implementation, so evidence from that scenario is DISTRIBUTIONAL/STRUCTURAL (invariant-checked across 50 independent seeds), never claimed as bit-exact H12 evidence. Where a scenario's perturbed values are constructed so that no fractional/RNG-consuming code path is ever reached (ProteinProcessingII Scenario A), the harness stub's specific RNG behavior is provably irrelevant to the outcome, so exact-match H12 evidence IS claimed for that scenario.

seeds.meaning: 50 independent RNG realizations (Octave `rand('seed', <id>)`) applied to the SAME pre-registered initial state per scenario -- NOT 50 different initial states. This directly tests whether the scenario's outcome is deterministic (PPII Scenario A: expect all 50 seeds identical) or genuinely stochastic (Macromolecular network_ge2 Monte Carlo: expect seed-to-seed variation, itself part of the evidence).

macromolecular_complexation_network2_com.goal: Make network 2's upper bound (ub) strictly positive for BOTH of its two complexes so buildProteinComplexs_montecarlokinetic's genuine sequential Monte Carlo competition loop actually executes (network 2 is the only network with >1 complex in this fixture; both complexes are structurally always ub==0 in the natural trace because one required substrate is a real fixture-constant 0).

derivation.substrate[23]: 51 -- within the REAL observed natural-trace range [50, 53] (mean 51.0) for this index; unperturbed (representative real value).
derivation.substrate[37]: 34 -- REAL fixture-constant value observed at every seed/tick in the natural trace; unperturbed.
derivation.substrate[42]: 31 -- REAL fixture-constant value observed at every seed/tick in the natural trace; unperturbed.
derivation.substrate[192]: 40 -- PERTURBED. Real fixture-constant 0 at every seed/tick in the natural trace (this is the structural reason ub==0 always: stoichiometry column for both complexes requires 2 units of substrate 192, so ratio=0/2=0 is always the binding minimum). Set to 40, within the SAME real range observed for its network-2 sibling substrates ([31, 53]), i.e. restored to the same order of magnitude as its co-substrates rather than an arbitrarily large or fitted value.
derivation.resulting_ub_by_hand: ub[complex0] = floor(min(51/1, 34/2, 31/0=inf, 40/2)) = floor(min(51, 17, inf, 20)) = 17; ub[complex1] = floor(min(51/1, 34/0=inf, 31/2, 40/2)) = floor(min(51, inf, 15.5, 20)) = 15. Both strictly positive -- genuine competition (previously both were exactly 0 in every natural sample).

macromolecular_complexation_network2_com.expected_regime: regime_valid=False under predict_macromolecular_complexation's own existing guard (ub>0 for network>=2 is, by that predictor's documented design, the genuine-competition case it correctly declines to exact-match-predict); genuinely stochastic outcome that is expected to VARY across the 50 independent seeds.
macromolecular_complexation_network2_com.validation_profile: DISTRIBUTIONAL/STRUCTURAL invariants only, never exact-match, never used to force H12_CONFIRMED: (1) built complex counts are non-negative integers, (2) built[c] <= ub[c] for both complexes (upper-bound never violated), (3) remaining substrate pool after building is non-negative dimension-wise (mass balance), (4) the process terminates in a finite number of iterations, (5) outcomes vary across at least 2 distinct seeds among the 50 (empirically demonstrating genuine RNG-dependence, i.e. that the predictor's regime_valid=False declination is not vacuous).
